name: Shuang
description: 帮助你快速上手双拼输入法

scripts.build: npm run clear && npm run build:src && npm run rename && npm run build:svg && npm run build:spa
scripts.build:src: npm run bundle && npm run build:js && npm run build:css && npm run build:html
scripts.build:js: npx babel src/app.bundle.js -d build && npx babel src/scheme -d build/scheme && npx babel src/keyboard-layout -d build/keyboard-layout
scripts.build:html: npx html-minifier --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-optional-tags --remove-redundant-attributes --remove-script-type-attributes --remove-tag-whitespace --use-short-doctype --minify-css true --minify-js true index.src.html -o index.html
scripts.build:spa: node scripts/generate-icons.js && node scripts/generate-screenshots.js && node scripts/copy.js manifest.json build/manifest.json && node scripts/copy.js sw.js build/sw.js && node scripts/copy.js icon-192.png build/icon-192.png && node scripts/copy.js icon-512.png build/icon-512.png && node scripts/copy.js icon-192-maskable.png build/icon-192-maskable.png && node scripts/copy.js icon-512-maskable.png build/icon-512-maskable.png && node scripts/copy.js screenshot-mobile.png build/screenshot-mobile.png && node scripts/copy.js screenshot-desktop.png build/screenshot-desktop.png
scripts.debug: npm run clear && npm run debug:src && npm run rename && npm run debug:spa
scripts.debug:src: npm run bundle && npm run debug:js && npm run debug:css && npm run debug:html
scripts.debug:spa: echo 'PWA files already in root directory for debug'
